name: Four Seasons Resort AMAALA at Triple Bay
positioning: Wellness-focused beach resort on Saudi Arabia's northwestern Red Sea coast, opened in June 2026
best_for: Travelers who want a wellness-focused beach stay with a spa and thermal circuit
Families who want a kids program, a teen club and a family pool

facts.text: Four Seasons announced Resort and Residences AMAALA at Triple Bay as now open on June 15, 2026.
The resort is on Saudi Arabia's northwestern Red Sea coast.
The resort has 202 guest rooms, suites and garden villas.
The resort's beachfront extends 900 metres (0.6 miles).
HYLIAA Wellness & Spa covers 2,095 square metres (22,550 square feet).
The resort has six open-air restaurants and lounges.
The resort has a 24-hour indoor-outdoor fitness centre.
The resort has two tennis courts.
The resort has three padel courts.
The resort is a five-minute walk from additional dining, shops and entertainment at the Yacht Club and Marina Village.

highlights.text: HYLIAA Wellness & Spa has a gender-specific thermal circuit.
The resort nutritionist can work with guests to design personalized menus.
The resort has a Kids For All Seasons program.
Guests can snorkel at the resort's reef.
Electric water activities at the resort include eFoils.
In 2026, Four Seasons Resort and Residences AMAALA at Triple Bay was named among La Liste's Top 5 Hotel Openings of the Year.

considerations.text: ZAATAR Restaurant is listed on the dining page as opening in late 2026.
WhataHotel notes the resort is in a newly developing destination where surrounding infrastructure is still evolving.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
